{{Kombat Navbox}} {{Infobox league |name=Kombat Race |tickername=Race Kombat |image=Kombato3.jpg |icon=Kombato3.jpg |admin={{player|us3|flag=fi}}, {{player|alice|flag=se}} |mode=race |format=One-day Single-Elimination Bracket ({{Abbr/Bo3}}) |tournaments=race |prizepool=Fame & Glory |entrance= |website=discord.gg/R6nkeCjvEB |sdate=2021-09-05 |map1=dm6 |map2=aerowalk |map3=ztndm3 |map4=slide6 }} '''Kombat Race''' is a one-day race tournament played '''Sunday 5th September''', 21:00 {{Abbr/CEST}}. The ambition is to bring more quick and easy tournaments into Quakeworld that doesn't require scheduling for each and every match. Basic race commands: * Set race mode with '''/race''' * '''/race_route_switch''' * '''/ready''' to get in line == Format == * Single-Elimination * Each '''route''' is played as a best of 5 runs. * And every match in bracket is '''best of 3 route wins.'''
''(Meaning you play best-of-3 x best-of-5-runs)'' == Routes == * AEROWALK '''route#5''' * ZTNDM3 '''route#2''' * ZTNDM3 '''route#3''' * DM6 '''route#2''' * SLIDE6 '''route#2''' == Rules == * Route order: cmd rnd for player1 first pick. then player2 pick. p1 toss, p2 toss, remaining route as decider. * If both fail a run of a route, the run is replayed. * International tournament, fair and equal ping all matches. * Client: ezQuake * +attack;+jump allowed * cl_delay_packet allowed as long as its not changed during race any other script is banned * Ruleset: default+mfi-s (or any other as long
